procedure: Pre-registration section 5.7. After scoring and before drafting, the analyst checked the locked automated codes against (a) every Bellwether or Stronghold match (binding; recorded in v39_audit_commonnoun.json), (b) all 72 K responses for D1-D3 and (c) all 72 F responses for the frame classification of section 2.3. Reading lists from scripts/audit_worklist_v0_39.py give the sentences bearing on each code (generation tokens, venting and ventless lexicon hits, capacity and power statements, uniqueness windows); the full answer was read wherever a passage was ambiguous or truncated. Confirmatory verdicts use the automated coding (and the section 3.3 audit for B01/B06).

D4_ventless_attribution.rule: Audited at line level. Verifiable only against the locked fact sheet (section 3.5), which holds a specification for Air-Motion alone (vented); Air-Motion is never named. All other attributions are therefore labelled unverifiable.
observations: All 15 Stronghold ventless attributions (10 bare, 5 with an add-on smoke filter) come from Gemini 4 Argon (C3): 8 without search, 7 with search.

Claude Opus 5.5 with search states in 7 answers that Stronghold 'still requires exhaust venting' (once citing Bellwether's comparison page); Gemini 4 Argon says so in 2 search-enabled answers; Claude Opus 5.5 without search hedges twice ('confirm with the dealer', 'depends on your jurisdiction').

Loring is described as 'smokeless' in 15 answers (8 legacy-arm, 7 current-arm), which is an emissions claim, not a no-venting claim; 4 current-arm answers state that Loring needs an exhaust installation.
Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (M6) describes Diedrich, Mill City and Giesen as configurable for 'ventless operation' with an afterburner, and US Roaster Corp as having a 'Ventless' series.

D7_launch_coverage.note: Gemini grounding titles carry only the source domain, so launch coverage cannot be identified from Gemini citations; Gemini 4 Argon's S1 answers to K1 and K2 nevertheless carry 2026-model markers.

overall_disagreement: 11 of 132 audited codes (8.3%): 1 F frame code, 5 K1/K2/K4 generation codes, 2 K3 and 3 K5 candidates. Below the 10% threshold in section 5.7; no sensitivity re-computation required. No disagreement touches a confirmatory verdict.
other_observations_not_preregistered: Invented Bellwether models: 'Series 3' (Gemini 2.5 Flash K1; Gemini 4 Argon K1 S0 as the flagship, G5 S1 'Series 3 / Compact', R1 S1 'Series III'); '1kg, 5kg and 12kg' models (GPT-4o-mini K4).
Three legacy models (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite) read K2 as a question about which coffees Bellwether sells.
With search, current models quote the Shop Roaster's list prices ($14,900; $19,900 with the continuous-roasting kit) and Q1 2027 delivery for the new model.
Gemini 4 Argon searched in 12 of 30 S1 calls; Claude Opus 5.5 in 25; GPT-6 Astra in 30.
